description: Exactly one of the two label kinds, never a mix. An outbound label answers Label (poNumber and assignmentId always present, no purpose); a reverse label (ADR 0017) answers ReturnLabel (purpose RETURN and returnAuthorizationId always present, no poNumber, no assignmentId). The required properties tell the two apart.

oneOf.description: Label metadata. Never contains the ship-to address. labelRef, trackingNumber and carrier are what vendor-connectivity returns to the vendor.

Metadata of a reverse label, the label of one package of a customer return (ADR 0017). Never contains the ship-to address. A reverse label has no purchase order and no fulfillment assignment, so it carries neither poNumber nor assignmentId; it always carries purpose RETURN and the returnAuthorizationId it belongs to. orderId is the outbound order whose ship-to is the return's pickup address.

purpose.description: Always RETURN. An outbound label (the Label schema) has no purpose property.

returnAuthorizationId.description: The return authorization the reverse label belongs to.
